caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your smartphone screen isn't sensing pressure, it's sensing an invisible electrical disturbance!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Your screen has an invisible grid of electrical circuits.
🔹 This grid constantly emits a weak electric field.
🔹 Your finger, carrying its own tiny electrical charge, disturbs this field when it touches.
🔹 The phone instantly detects where the disturbance occurred, acting like an 'invisible electrical map'!
